business_problem: Avant Group Corporation provides systems and operational services to visualize and improve the corporate value of their customers through four operating companies. Under the corporate philosophy of creating a 100-year, globally known company, Avant Group is accelerating efforts to promote digital transformation (DX) to enhance their competitiveness and corporate value.
solution_summary: Avant Group Corporation provides systems and operational services to visualize and improve the corporate value of their customers through four operating companies. Under the corporate philosophy of creating a 100-year, globally known company, Avant Group is accelerating efforts to promote digital transformation (DX) to enhance their competitiveness and corporate value. To build an environment where IT can be used safely anytime, anywhere, the Group uses a blend of cloud services such as Microsoft 365 and Azure along with on-premises systems. architecture_clues: Avant Group Corporation provides systems and operational services to visualize and improve the corporate value of their customers through four operating companies. Under the corporate philosophy of creating a 100-year, globally known company, Avant Group is accelerating efforts to promote digital transformation (DX) to enhance their competitiveness and corporate value. To build an environment where IT can be used safely anytime, anywhere, the Group uses a blend of cloud services such as Microsoft 365 and Azure along with on-premises systems. They wanted to introduce a virtual desktop environment where operating companies and business partners could work safely and without stress and have met those needs with Windows 365, which they have found to be easy to operate and provide to even just one user at a reasonable cost.

The Group uses cloud services such as Microsoft 365 and Azure for their internal IT environment, along with on-premises systems in a hybrid manner. In July 2022, they adopted Windows 365 , a software as a service (SaaS) solution that creates a Windows 365 Cloud PC to deliver a complete Windows experience for each user from the Microsoft Cloud

Mr. Takayuki Saito, Head of the IT Planning Group within the Group IT Promotion Department at Avant Group Corporation, explains, “When supporting accounting operations, it’s very important to give your employees thin clients so that data cannot be saved to local storage. Each of the four operating companies works with business partners to provide services to customers. About three years ago, we prepared to provide virtual desktops from Avant Group for the laptops used by our business partners. At that time, we were building a virtual desktop environment on the assumption that it would be used by several hundred people. But the needs of the field have changed over the past two to three years, and now it’s desirable to have an environment that can be set up quickly and easily for a small number of users. The cost of a conventional virtual desktop environment doesn’t match that use case. So, when we started considering what would be a suitable virtual desktop environment for our Group going forward, Windows 365 appeared at a good time.”

Avant Group found Windows 365 appealing for three reasons—improved security, ease of introduction and operation, and ease of use. According to Mr. Kaga, the clarity of the pricing system was particularly important in making operations easier. “At Avant Group, we use an IT chargeback model, procuring licenses and charging each business department that uses them. With Windows 365, people can use dedicated resources for a flat rate, which makes it simpler to manage IT costs. I think this has great value.”

Under the corporate philosophy of creating a 100-year, globally known company, Avant Group is accelerating efforts to promote digital transformation (DX) to enhance their competitiveness and corporate value. To build an environment where IT can be used safely anytime, anywhere, the Group uses a blend of cloud services such as Microsoft 365 and Azure along with on-premises systems. They wanted to introduce a virtual desktop environment where operating companies and business partners could work safely and without stress and have met those needs with Windows 365, which they have found to be easy to operate and provide to even just one user at a reasonable cost.

Regarding deployment, Mr. Hanano says, “Windows 365 works well with Azure and Microsoft 365, and we completed our preliminary verification smoothly. For employees who want Windows 365, we set up Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) in advance. Then all you have to do is install the app through Microsoft Intune, a mobile device management tool, and set up the URL for access. If business partners and others want to use their own devices, two-factor authentication is mandatory, but such management can also be done centrally. Both the allocation and deletion of Windows 365 can be completed in just a few minutes using Microsoft Entra ID and Intune. It was exactly the same when we switched the environment to Windows 365 for employees participating in overseas projects. I did it while sitting in my seat at the office. It’s very convenient.”
